extName.message: Fixproof — bug reports for AI fixing

extDescription.message: Mark a bug on any page: element, annotated screenshot and tech context go to your GitHub repo or Mesila board for your AI agent.

hintElement.message: Click the element with the problem · ↑ parent block · Esc to cancel

hintArea.message: Drag over the area with the problem · Esc to cancel

noSetup.message: Fixproof is not set up yet.

noProject.message: This site is not in any project: choose one.

titlePlaceholder.message: What is wrong, in a few words

descriptionPlaceholder.message: What you expected, steps to repeat…

catcherOff.message: Console errors are collected only on project sites you allowed in the settings

optIntro.message: Bug reports with a screenshot and full context, sent to a GitHub tasks repository or a Mesila board.

optTokenHelp.message: A fine-grained token with Issues: read and write and Contents: read and write on your tasks repositories. Create a token. Stored only in this browser.

optProjectsHelp.message: One project per site: tickets go to its GitHub tasks repository or Mesila board. Sites: the addresses where the button should know which project it is (live, test, local).

optPerm.message: Collect console errors on these sites

optNoOrigins.message: Add at least one site address

optPermOk.message: Allowed: console errors will be collected from the next page load

optMesilaTokenHelp.message: An agent token from Mesila → Settings → AI agents (msl_…). Stored only in this browser.

optBadMesilaUrl.message: Mesila address must start with http:// or https://

optBadBoard.message: Board key: 2–10 Latin letters or digits, like MSL

queued.message: Could not send right now — the ticket is saved and will be sent automatically. You can close this.

queuedAction.message: Saved in the outbox: fix the project settings, then it will be sent

outboxNoProject.message: The project was removed from the settings

outboxNoAccess.message: No token or address in the project settings

optOutboxHelp.message: Tickets that could not be sent yet. They are retried automatically (also after a browser restart); a ticket that needs your action waits until the project settings are fixed.

optOutboxDeleteConfirm.message: Delete this ticket with its screenshot? It was not sent.

optShortcutNone.message: Not assigned — the reporter opens only from the toolbar button.

optShortcutHelp.message: Opens the bug reporter on the current page. Chrome assigns shortcuts on its own page (chrome://extensions/shortcuts); after reinstalling the extension or if another extension took the keys, set it there.
